easyPrerequisites: You have a way to cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
description:
Activate Oko's first loyalty ability by putting two loyalty counters on it, causing Weftstalker Ardent to indefinitely gain all creature types including Pirate.
Cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
Weftstalker Ardent triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating a Treasure token for each opponent dealt damage this way.
When the Treasure(s) enter, Weftstalker Ardent triggers at least once.
Resolve a Weftstalker Ardent trigger, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Repeat from step 4.

uses.name: Oko, Lorwyn Liege // Oko, Shadowmoor Scion
